description:
Check whether a Knowledge Stack background workflow is still running.

`ask` and `extract` return a `workflow_id`; so do the backend's ingest,
re-embed and reclassify jobs. Pass one here to find out whether it
succeeded, failed, or is still going — useful when a call timed out and
you need to know whether the work is still in flight before retrying
and doing it twice.

Read `state` (`running` / `succeeded` / `failed` / `cancelled` /
`unknown`) rather than the raw `temporal_status`, and `is_terminal` to
decide whether polling again can change the answer.

This is a single point-in-time read, not a wait. Do not call it in a
tight loop: if `is_terminal` is false, tell the user the work is still
running and let them ask again, or leave a gap proportional to
`elapsed_s` before the next check.

An unknown id comes back with `found=false` rather than as an error —
workflows age out of Temporal's retention window, so "not there" does
not mean "failed".

workflow_id.description: Workflow id to look up — e.g. the `workflow_id` returned by `ask` or by an ingest call.
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

name: get_workflow_status

outputSchema.description: Point-in-time state of one Temporal workflow owned by the caller's tenant.

closed_at.description: ISO-8601 close time; null while still running.
closed_at.title: Closed At

elapsed_s.description: Seconds from start to close, or to now if still running. Use it to pace polling instead of retrying in a tight loop.
elapsed_s.title: Elapsed S

found.description: False when no workflow with this id is visible to the tenant — either a bad id, or a run old enough to have aged out of Temporal's retention. Every other field is then unset; do not read absence as failure.
found.title: Found

is_terminal.description: True once the run has stopped for good. While false the result may still change, so a later poll can return something different.
is_terminal.title: Is Terminal

run_id.description: Temporal run id — the specific attempt, distinct from the id.
run_id.title: Run Id

state.description: Normalized outcome: `running` | `succeeded` | `failed` | `cancelled` | `unknown`. Branch on this rather than on ``temporal_status``.
state.title: State

task_queue.description: Temporal task queue it ran on.
task_queue.title: Task Queue

temporal_status.description: Raw Temporal status name (e.g. `RUNNING`, `COMPLETED`), for logs.
temporal_status.title: Temporal Status

workflow_id.description: The workflow id you asked about.
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

workflow_type.description: Which workflow ran (e.g. the ingest or agent workflow).
workflow_type.title: Workflow Type

outputSchema.title: WorkflowStatus
